conversation.content: I have two Atlanta trips, BK-EP04A and BK-EP04B. They are the same route, but one is basic economy and one is regular economy. Can you compare my baggage rules on both?

Here’s the baggage comparison for your two Atlanta trips, using your Gold status:

| Booking | Cabin | Carry-on | Free checked bags | Extra checked bag fee | Oversize fee |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| BK-EP04A | Basic Economy | 1 | 2 | $50 each beyond free allowance | $100 |
| BK-EP04B | Economy | 1 | 3 | $35 each beyond free allowance | $100 |

Quick breakdown:
- Both bookings include 1 carry-on.
- BK-EP04A is Basic Economy:
  - Base allowance: 0 checked bags
  - Gold bonus: +2 checked bags
  - Total free checked bags: 2
- BK-EP04B is regular Economy:
  - Base allowance: 1 checked bag
  - Gold bonus: +2 checked bags
  - Total free checked bags: 3

So the key difference is:
- Economy gives you 1 more free checked bag than Basic Economy
- And any additional paid checked bags are cheaper on Economy: $35 vs $50

If you want, I can also compare change/cancel rules between those two fares.

Thanks, that helps. Practically, if I bring three checked bags on BK-EP04A versus three checked bags on BK-EP04B, can you walk through those separately and tell me which plan is more fee-efficient? On BK-EP04B I’d prefer to avoid paying extra if possible.

Sure — for exactly 3 checked bags:

- BK-EP04A, Basic Economy:
  - Free checked bags: 2
  - You bring: 3
  - Paid bags: 1
  - Cost: 1 × $50 = $50

- BK-EP04B, Economy:
  - Free checked bags: 3
  - You bring: 3
  - Paid bags: 0
  - Cost: $0

Most fee-efficient plan:
- Put the 3 checked bags on BK-EP04B if you can, since it covers all 3 with no extra charge.
- Bringing 3 checked bags on BK-EP04A would cost you $50.

So BK-EP04B is better by $50, and it matches your preference to avoid paying extra.

Got it — that’s exactly what I needed. Just to confirm, this is advice only and not a request to add or modify anything, and BK-EP04B is the better three-bag plan because all 3 are covered there while BK-EP04A would mean 1 extra-bag charge of $50. [TASK_DONE]
